conventions: Change only what a site names. This is a refactor: no renames, no reformatting of nearby lines, no behaviour change for a React 18 user.

Prettier formats TypeScript, JSON and Markdown here (2 spaces, single quotes, trailing commas, 80 columns, arrowParens avoid). Files matched by .prettierignore (*.hbs, report.api.md, knip-report.md) are edited by hand and keep their exact table and signature layout.
TypeScript is strict and JSX uses the react-jsx transform, so never add `import React`. Do not add default exports or React.FC.
Leave existing copyright years as they are. This change creates no new source file, so no new Apache header is needed.
Keep the existing key order in every package.json. JSON has no trailing commas, so when the last entry of an object is removed, the entry before it loses its comma.
Do not run yarn build, yarn changesets version, yarn release or the changeset CLI. yarn.lock is written only by the install step.
Tests are Jest, run from the repo root as `CI=1 yarn test <path>`, with `describe`/`it` and React Testing Library's `findBy*` and `waitFor`.
Changesets are Markdown with YAML front matter: single-quoted package names, one per line, then a blank line and the message. Messages are for adopters, in plain language, and name only public API.

decisions.topic: Root rendering in dev-utils, frontend-dev-utils and techdocs
decisions.choice: A static named import, `import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';`, called directly. It replaces the side-effect `import 'react-dom';` in the two dev packages and the module-level ReactDOMPromise everywhere.
rejected: Keep a promise from `import('react-dom/client')`: the lazy import existed only because React 17 has no such module
A default import: the mock in createDevApp.test.tsx provides only a named createRoot
decisions.reason: FR-8 asks for direct use. react-dom/client requires react-dom, so the side-effect import is redundant, and react-dom is an eager shared dependency on the module federation host, so a static import is safe there.

decisions.choice: Remove the checkReactVersion function and its call.
rejected: Reword it to name React 18: it would still fire only on React 16, which was already unsupported
decisions.reason: The check can no longer fire on a supported setup, which is the case FR-12 says to remove.

decisions.choice: Peer range change: major for packages at 1.0.0 or above, minor below, in two changesets with one message. legacyRoot: major for @backstage/test-utils. repo-tools, cli-module-build and cli-module-test-jest: minor. cli-module-new, ui and eslint-plugin: patch. app-example-plugin and @internal/plugin-todo-list are private and get none.
rejected: One minor or patch changeset for all packages: Gate 1 chose the repo rule read literally
decisions.reason: Gate 1 approved the literal bump rule. Versions come from .changeset/pre.json initialVersions. dev-utils, frontend-dev-utils, frontend-plugin-api, plugin-app and techdocs source changes need no extra entry because the peer range message covers them.

decisions.choice: Hand-edit only cli-module-build and plugins/app, whose entries change. Leave the frontend-plugin-api and ui reports as they are.
rejected: Run yarn build:knip-reports: it would rewrite reports unrelated to this change
decisions.reason: No entry in those two reports is removed, and their line numbers already differ from their manifests today.
